architecture_contract.selected_model: EPInformer_v2 HepG2 RNA f3 with the matching fold-specific HepG2 enhancer encoder

enhancer_encoder.sequence_encoder: one stem convolution followed by four residual convolution/max-pooling stages

expression_model.interaction_encoder: three transformer encoder layers with four attention heads and promoter-enhancer-only attention masking
expression_model.sequence_slots: one 2-kb promoter plus up to sixty 2-kb ABC-nominated enhancer slots
expression_model.upstream_cross_validation: twelve leave-two-chromosomes-out folds with separate train, validation, and test chromosome assignments

architecture_contract.source_cell_context: HepG2 transformed hepatoblastoma cell line; not a MASLD donor, primary hepatocyte, stellate cell, or disease state

checkpoint_set.ordered_manifest_format: For fold 1 through 12, enhancer path TAB LFS SHA-256 TAB size NEWLINE, followed by expression path TAB LFS SHA-256 TAB size NEWLINE.

implementation.weight_repository_card_warning: The model card usage example names JiecongLin/EPInformer-pipeline although the exact inspected repository identity is JiecongLin/EPInformer; resolve this documentation mismatch before acquisition or loading.

input_contract.candidate_nomination: ABC-nominated open-chromatin elements within 100 kb of the target TSS, capped at 60 in a fixed order
input_contract.enhancer_activity: HepG2 H3K27ac/DNase-derived activity from the upstream pipeline; no GSE289173 ATAC exists and missing activity cannot be replaced with zero
input_contract.gene_authority: The checkpoint was trained on an upstream 18,377-protein-coding-gene/Xpresso roster and TSS/split authority. A GENCODE v49 remap changes candidates and is not silently equivalent.
input_contract.hic: The HepG2 pipeline documents cell-specific or ABC average Hi-C depending on available input. The exact per-gene contact artifact and source must be frozen and hashed before use.
input_contract.promoter_and_enhancer_sequence: 2-kb one-hot A/C/G/T sequence per slot; N is all-zero and absent enhancer slots are zero-padded. Structural absence must remain masked rather than interpreted as biological inactivity.
input_contract.reverse_complement: The enhancer encoder's published evaluation averages forward and reverse-complement predictions, while expression HDF5 construction includes strand handling. Exact f3 expression and attention behavior must be reproduced and frozen before a variant fixture.
input_contract.sealed_context: Only a precommitted native HepG2/reference link atlas can be queried at GSE289173. No sealed donor expression, eQTL outcome, or missing donor ATAC may be converted into f3 features.

output_and_task_contract.admitted_output: Per-promoter relative enhancer attention score, normalized over the frozen candidate enhancer set
output_and_task_contract.attention_interpretation: Unsigned prioritization score for a candidate enhancer-to-gene relationship; it is not a calibrated probability and changes when the candidate set or upstream features change.
output_and_task_contract.native_model_output: The expression head predicts a HepG2 RNA expression scalar, but that scalar is not admitted as a signed variant effect in this task.
output_and_task_contract.task_role: link_only comparator for enhancer-gene retrieval and optional component of a separately frozen variant activity plus link composite
output_and_task_contract.variant_rule: A sealed variant can overlap a precommitted candidate enhancer and inherit its frozen link score. Sequence substitution, in-silico perturbation, or expression-delta scoring is not admitted under the current link-only capability and unresolved code terms.

runtime_contract.declared_environment: Python 3.10 with unpinned PyTorch and scientific/ABC dependencies in environment.yml
runtime_contract.gpu_required: upstream pipeline uses GPU; small inference may be CPU-capable but is not assumed without a fixture

safe_loading_contract.official_loader: torch.load(..., weights_only=False) followed by model_state_dict loading
required_if_terms_clear: verify every LFS SHA-256 and size
attempt weights_only=True in an isolated no-network process
extract and vendor tensor-only state dictionaries once
strict fold-paired encoder and expression loading
reject extra objects and executable globals

source_evidence: The primary Nature Communications paper, exact GitHub commit, Zenodo record metadata, exact Hugging Face revision, model card, and all 24 Git LFS pointers were queried on 2026-08-22. Public source text and pointer metadata were inspected. No checkpoint bytes, input data, package, or runtime were downloaded or executed.

terms_audit.code_license_evidence: The paper states that release v0.1.1 is under MIT, but neither that tag nor the selected later commit contains a LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE file. The Zenodo concept currently resolves to v0.3.0 metadata marked CC-BY-4.0, which is not the selected commit. These conflicting and non-commit-bound statements do not license the exact selected code with sufficient certainty.
